findings.title: 부산역 2층 안내도 (station's own 2F floor-guide board, photographed 2025-05)
findings.whatItShows: Top-down schematic of 2F 대합실: 매표소, 역무실/유실물, 수유방, 철도경찰, 회의실, 코레일라운지, 3× W.C, 종합안내, ATM, EV, escalators to 1F/3F, boarding gates labelled 7/8/9/10 with 기차 타는길 arrows, plus ~25 tenant positions. No scale bar/north arrow. [raster 1941x1267 px]
findings.usefulFor: Primary room-topology source for the 2F 대합실 volume already present in OfficialBusanStation_MainShell.fbx: fixes which partition walls exist and where 매표소/화장실/수유실/사무실/gates sit relative to each other.
findings.license: Naver blog, personal; photo of public station signage (KORAIL signage = public facility wayfinding). Unlicensed for redistribution; reference use only.

findings.title: 부산역 1층 안내도 (1F floor-guide board)
findings.whatItShows: 1F plan schematic: 물품보관함, 짐배송, 편의점, 식당존, 화장실, 출입구 positions along the station front. [raster 1934x1057 px]
findings.usefulFor: 1F room subdivision and door/entrance positions; pairs with the 2F board for vertical alignment of cores.
findings.license: Naver blog, personal; photo of KORAIL public signage.

findings.title: 부산역 3층 안내도 (3F floor-guide board)
findings.whatItShows: 3F plan schematic: 전문식당가 tenant band, toilets, elevator/escalator arrivals. Smallest of the three levels. [raster 1926x1060 px]
findings.usefulFor: 3F mezzanine footprint — tells you how much of the 2F ceiling void is occupied by a 3F slab.
findings.license: Naver blog, personal; photo of KORAIL public signage.

findings.title: 부산역 편의시설 안내도 signboard photo, 2026-08 (current revision, 3F+2F plans on one board)
findings.whatItShows: Photo of the in-station 'BUSAN STATION CONVENIENCE FACILITIES MAP' board: 3F plan (전문식당가, EV, toilets, keys 2–4) and 2F plan (타는 곳 tracks, EV, escalators, keys 5–13) with a numbered 1–30 tenant legend. [raster 2000x1500 px]
findings.usefulFor: Most recent (2026-08) state of the interior; use to reconcile the 2025 boards against present-day tenancy and confirm gate/EV positions did not move.
findings.license: Naver blog, personal; photo of KORAIL public signage.

findings.title: 부산역 편의시설 안내도 board, full-board shots (portrait, 2000×2667)
findings.whatItShows: Full-height capture of the same official facilities-guide board plus adjacent concourse context (BUSAN Toy Zone, AED, photo booth) — shows real fixture/furniture placement in the 2F concourse. [raster 2000x2667 px]
findings.usefulFor: Furniture and kiosk placement evidence for the 2F concourse; also ties board content to a physical wall location.

findings.title: 부산역 전 매장 약도 — stacked 3F/2F/1F schematic plan with GATE1–GATE10
findings.whatItShows: Cleanly redrawn vector-style stacked plan of all three above-ground levels. Outlines shops/facilities, labels 매표창구, 자동발매기, 철도경찰서, 역무실, 수유실, 전문식당가, 타는곳 with direction arrows, and numbers every boarding gate GATE1–GATE10. Escalator/elevator/toilet icons. No scale bar. [raster 2000x2293 px]
findings.usefulFor: Best single overview of vertical stacking + gate count/ordering; directly drives placement of the platform-access gate line along the 2F north edge.
findings.license: Commercial blog (짐캐리) redrawn graphic. Unlicensed; reference use only.

findings.title: 부산역 전 매장 약도 — per-floor detail sheets (9 variants, highlight-per-tenant)
findings.whatItShows: Single-floor enlargements of the same schematic at 2000×1196 / 2000×655; each variant highlights a different tenant cell, so overlaying them recovers per-tenant cell boundaries. [raster 2000x1196 px]
findings.usefulFor: Recovering individual retail-unit footprints (partition positions) by differencing the highlight masks — the closest thing to per-room polygons available publicly. Other 8 sheets sit beside this file (hi_zimcarry_*_66/69/70/71/72/81/82/83).

findings.title: KORAIL 역 상세정보 — 부산역 층별 시설안내 (official per-floor facility register)
findings.whatItShows: KORAIL's own page text: confirms the station operates six levels (지하2층, 지하1층, 지상1–4층) and lists ~40 tenants each tagged with its floor; plus the official history note that the 2004 rebuild was enlarged again in 2010-11 when the 2층 맞이방 and parking were expanded.
findings.usefulFor: Authoritative floor-count and per-floor program list to validate any plan you trace; the 4F/B1/B2 entries prove levels exist that the signage boards omit.

findings.title: 부산역 이용(대피)안내도 — 부산교통공사 official station diagram (Line 1, st. code 113)
findings.whatItShows: Official isometric cutaway of the Busan Metro 부산역 station: platform level, concourse/ticketing level, exits 1–7, stairs/escalators/lifts, toilets, extinguishers, and red dashed evacuation routes toward 초량역/중앙역. [raster 1000x661 px]
findings.usefulFor: The B1/B2 underground level that connects to the KTX station — gives exit numbering and the vertical-circulation pattern for the basement link that the KTX-side boards do not cover.
findings.license: 부산교통공사 (public corporation) official asset; 공공누리-style public material.

findings.title: 부산교통공사 부산역 station photos (113_1/2/3.jpg)
findings.whatItShows: Three 360×225 official station-info thumbnails of the metro station interior/entrances. [raster 360x225 px]
findings.usefulFor: Low-value visual corroboration only; too small to georeference.

findings.title: 국가철도공단 철도설계기준(건축편) KR A-02031 건물의 규모계획 (+4 companion standards)
findings.whatItShows: The national normative standard that sizes Korean railway-station rooms: 대합실 area per peak passenger, 매표소 counter module, 화장실 fixture counts, corridor/stair widths, ceiling heights. Downloaded alongside KR A-01020 (설계방향), KR A-01030 (설계의 조건), KR A-02050 (방재계획), KR A-03090 (방재설계).
findings.usefulFor: Turns the unscaled signage schematics into metric geometry: gives defensible widths for 매표소 counters, toilet blocks, corridors and door openings when no dimensioned drawing exists.
findings.license: 국가철도공단 public design standard (free download, no login).

findings.title: 부산역사문화대전 — 부산역 건축 제원
findings.whatItShows: Published figures: 대지면적 214,365.71㎡, 연면적 61,483.93㎡, 지상 5층/지하 1층, 철골+RC, 5 passenger platforms.
findings.usefulFor: Global sanity check on total interior floor area — lets you test whether a traced interior subdivision sums to a plausible 61,483.93㎡ across levels.

findings.title: 나무위키 부산역 — 승강장 구조 및 역사 연혁
findings.whatItShows: Station is 5면 12선 복합식 (5 island platforms / 12 tracks); detailed 2004 rebuild chronology and the 2010 2층 맞이방 expansion; 배선도 section.
findings.usefulFor: Fixes the number of platform-access gate stacks that must pierce the 2F north wall (5 platforms → 10 numbered gates, matching GATE1–GATE10 on the 약도).

findings.title: 카카오맵 기차역 실내지도 — 부산역 included (54 stations, built with KORAIL, opened 2025-05-02)
findings.whatItShows: Kakao's own press release confirming floor-by-floor indoor maps with store positions, elevators, escalators and toilets exist for 부산역. Kakao search JSON exposes the handle: confirmid=8329752, indoor_info zoneid=181917, default floor 2, WCONGNAMUL x=965303 y=454459 (lon 129.04155, lat 35.115204).
findings.usefulFor: The only machine-readable, georeferenced indoor vector dataset known to cover this station. zoneid 181917 + the WGS84 anchor is what you would use to align extracted floor polygons to the Unity world origin.

findings.title: 국가철도공단 역사 준공도면 (as-built station drawings, DWG) on data.go.kr
findings.whatItShows: Real, free-download DWG as-built drawings for railway stations, explicitly described as showing 대합실/개찰구/승강장 구조 for 실내공간정보 체계 구축. Published set covers only 상봉, 망포, 매교, 매탄권선, 수원시청, 청명·영통.
findings.usefulFor: Proves KR publishes station as-builts in DWG and establishes the exact dataset shape to request for 부산역 via 정보공개청구; also a format reference for what a usable interior source looks like.

findings.title: 국토지리정보원 실내공간정보 구축 — 철도역사 약 90개소 ('22~)
findings.whatItShows: NGII business plan stating indoor spatial information (IndoorGML-class) was being built for ~90 railway stations at 철도경찰대's request from 2022 onward.
findings.usefulFor: Names the government programme that most plausibly already holds a surveyed indoor model of 부산역; the realistic acquisition route is a written request to 국토지리정보원/철도특별사법경찰대.

findings.title: OSM building footprints for 부산역 — TRUE minimum-area footprints (cross-lane artifact from ModelHunt, re-derived and confirmed here)
findings.whatItShows: Minimum-area enclosing rectangles (rotating calipers in a local ENU frame), independently recomputed in this lane and agreeing with ModelHunt to within rounding: way/165346394 역사 head-house = 80.5 x 31.4 m, 2527 m², long axis on compass bearing 108.0°; way/165346389 whole complex = 371.6 x 180.1 m; the 6 railway=platform ways = 388–460 m long x 4.7–11.2 m wide, all on bearing ~20.4°, so head-house and platforms are ~87.6° apart. SUPERSEDES the earlier 350.1 x 253.4 m and 45 x 84 m figures, which were lat-lon axis-aligned bounding boxes of a building rotated ~19° off north and are not footprints. Bearings here are compass-from-north of the long axis; ModelHunt's companion file quotes the same geometry in a 90°-complement convention (162.0° / 69.6°). PRECISION CAVEAT: the OSM outlines are hand-traced, so treat 80.5 x 31.4 m as ~80.5 x 31.4 +/- noise and the bearing as 108.0 deg +/- ~1 deg; the 10 m2 area gap between this lane's 2527 m2 and ModelHunt's 2537 m2 is purely differing metres-per-degree constants and sits inside that noise floor. Do not let the third digit imply precision the source lacks.
findings.usefulFor: THE scale anchor this lane could not produce. Scale hi_shoobong_2층_안내도1.jpg so its plan outline fits 80.5 x 31.4 m and every room dimension on that board becomes metric. The identification is corroborated numerically: the known 2F 대합실 usable area of 1,820–1,992 m² is 72.0–78.8% of the 2,527 m² head-house footprint, a normal concourse net-to-gross, so way/165346394 is indeed the block the 2F board depicts. KR A-02031 drops from sole metric source to cross-check. Fit the FBX to the polygon by least squares rather than trusting the bearing scalar. The head-house is 87.6 deg from the platform axis, i.e. 2.4 deg OFF square to the tracks, which is 3.38 m of drift across its 80.5 m long axis — so the rotation must be measured against the polygon, never derived as platforms+90 deg. Axis bearings are mod 180: the acute angle is the real one (87.6 deg head-house vs platforms, 88.8 deg complex vs platforms); an obtuse complement is a sign of a sign error.

findings.title: 한국철도공사_역사 내외부 시설현황 — 부산 row (cross-lane artifact, acquired by ModelHunt)
findings.whatItShows: Verified directly from the CSV on disk: 부산 = 엘리베이터 13, 에스컬레이터 24, 장애인화장실 1, 일반화장실 1, 환승주차장 688면. 모유수유실 and 종합안내소 read 0, which contradicts the signage boards, so 0 means 'not recorded', not 'absent'.
findings.usefulFor: Hard element counts to audit the traced interior against. The 1F/2F/3F guide boards show only a handful of lifts and escalators, so they are confirmed PARTIAL-coverage wayfinding graphics, not complete building plans — back-of-house cores and platform-level circulation are missing from them.

findings.title: OSM railway=platform polygons with ref tags — resolves the gate-to-platform mapping
findings.whatItShows: 6 platform polygons carrying track refs 1, 3;4, 5;6, 8;9, 10;11 and one untagged. True footprints (min-area rectangles, recomputed in this lane): 388.3 x 4.7 m, 416.2 x 11.1 m, 430.8 x 10.6 m, 456.1 x 11.0 m, 457.2 x 11.2 m, 459.8 x 10.2 m, all on compass bearing ~20.4°.
findings.usefulFor: Closes the loop between 나무위키's 5면 12선, the 약도's GATE1–GATE10, and real-world position. The head-house long axis (108.0°) and the platform axis (20.4°) are ~87.6° apart, so the gates pierce the facade that faces the platforms: each numbered gate can be tied to a specific platform edge instead of staying topological. This is exactly the circulation the 층별안내도 boards omit, and where the surplus of the 13-lift / 24-escalator budget must go.

deadEnds.why: Rendered the page in a real browser: zero occurrences of '안내도' in the DOM and only one /file/ asset (an exterior station photo). KORAIL's site publishes a per-floor tenant list but NO 구내안내도 / floor-plan image.

Paginated the full keyword result set (11 datasets, page 4 empty). Station as-built DWGs exist for 상봉·망포·매교·매탄권선·수원시청·청명영통 only. 부산역 is absent — proven, independently confirmed by sibling agent ModelHunt.
map.ngii.go.kr/ms/mesrInfo/indrSpce.do returns HTTP 404; no public per-facility indoor download catalogue reachable. The ~90-station build exists on paper only as a programme description.

Opened the web map at the station and captured 192 network requests: only base raster tiles (mts.kakaocdn.net/api/v1/tile/PNG) and POI click JSON. No indoor tile/vector endpoint, and /inside/*, /indoor/*, /api/inside/* all return the generic KAKAO shell page. The 실내지도 is served to the mobile app only; zoneid 181917 is the handle but no web-reachable data URL exists.
map.naver.com/p/api/search/allSearch returns 403 outside the app context; browser capture at the station showed only evtp/poi event tiles — no indoor layer for 부산역.

searchTotalUp.do returns HTTP 404; no anonymous query endpoint. Pre-1953 부산역 drawings may exist there but are not web-reachable without the interactive portal.
BuildingDoc search page loads but carries no 부산역 project record; AURUM indexes policy/research documents, not station drawings.
No 부산역사 competition entry. The 2004 역사 was a 철도청 design-build, not a public 설계공모, so no competition PDF with floor plans exists to find.

deadEnds.source: 부산역 피난안내도 (evacuation plan for the KTX station building)
deadEnds.why: Searches return only the generic 피난안내도 authoring standards (소방청/국가기술표준원 templates). The station's own statutory 피난안내도 is posted physically inside the building and is not published online; the only official evacuation diagram reachable is 부산교통공사's subway-side 이용(대피)안내도, which was downloaded.
No open paper found that uses 부산역 as its case building; the retrieved simulation papers model 제주국제공항, cold-storage warehouses and MLCC cleanrooms instead.

deadEnds.source: Georeferencing metadata on every raster obtained
deadEnds.why: Measured all downloaded rasters with sips. Not one carries a scale bar, dimension string, or north arrow — every plan-like source in this lane is topological, not metric. Scale MUST come from the existing FBX bounds plus the KR A-02031 standard, not from these images.

deadEnds.source: Completeness of the 층별안내도 signage boards
deadEnds.why: Cross-checked against KORAIL's own facility census (엘리베이터 13, 에스컬레이터 24 at 부산). The downloaded boards depict far fewer vertical-circulation elements, so they cannot be treated as complete floor plans: they omit back-of-house cores, platform-level circulation and service rooms. Any interior built from them alone WILL be missing circulation.

deadEnds.source: Axis-aligned bounding boxes as footprints (the apparent FBX-vs-OSM 'conflict')
deadEnds.why: Retracted, not unresolved. The head-house sits ~19° off north, so lat-lon AABBs inflate it badly: 350.1 x 253.4 m and 45 x 84 m were AABBs, not footprints, and the Unity ~98 x 63 m figure has the same defect. Three AABBs of rotated objects cannot agree. Recomputing minimum-area rectangles gives 80.5 x 31.4 m for the head-house and removes the conflict entirely. Fit the FBX to that oriented rectangle; never compare bare extents.

deadEnds.source: Deriving the head-house rotation as platform bearing + 90 deg
deadEnds.why: Wrong by 2.4 deg. The head-house is not square to the tracks: measured acute angle is 87.6 deg, which drifts 3.38 m across the 80.5 m long axis. Axis bearings are mod 180, so a raw signed difference is meaningless and an obtuse figure like 91.2 deg indicates a sign error. Measure the rotation by least-squares fit against the polygon; part of the 2.4 deg may itself be OSM digitisation noise (+/- ~1 deg).

bestThreeForGeometry: asset-library/.../floorplans/hi_zimcarry_전_매장_약도_250212_77.png (2000×2293) — the only source that draws all three above-ground levels as stacked outlined plans with every platform gate numbered GATE1–GATE10, so it fixes both the vertical stacking and the gate line that must pierce the 2F north wall of the existing shell.

asset-library/.../floorplans/hi_shoobong_2층_안내도1.jpg (1941×1267) — a photo of the station's own 2F guide board, the single richest room inventory for the 2F 대합실 volume the FBX already contains: 매표소, 역무실/유실물, 수유방, 철도경찰, 회의실, 코레일라운지, 3× W.C, 종합안내, ATM, EV and escalator positions in their true relative arrangement.

asset-library/.../models/osm_footprint_obb_metres.json + busanstation_osm_footprint.geojson (ODbL, cross-lane) — the metric anchor, now resolved. True minimum-area footprint of the 역사 head-house is 80.5 x 31.4 m (2,527 m²) on bearing 108.0°, independently recomputed in this lane. The 2F 대합실's 1,820–1,992 m² is 72–79% of that, a textbook concourse net-to-gross, confirming this is the block the 2F board depicts — so scaling hi_shoobong_2층_안내도1.jpg to 80.5 x 31.4 m yields real room dimensions. kric_KR_A-02031_건물의_규모계획.pdf remains on disk as the independent cross-check on counter modules, toilet fixture counts, corridor and stair widths and ceiling heights.
